goal: VC-201-069 (P1) claims mastery of: Guide discovery and configuration of an available local runtime, an optional cloud provider, tools, and policy through validated plans; the completion check runs a real mission and reports missing prerequisites.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: the setup workflow detects the ecosystem, takes consent and applies, then summarises - verified by `tests/zc_setup_workflow.rs`: zc_setup_workflow_detect_consent_apply_summary. Residual: guiding discovery and configuration of a local runtime, an optional cloud provider, tools and policy through validated plans, and a completion check that runs a real mission and reports missing prerequisi. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_069_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence. Closing this task records the outcome, not a passing test: write .agents/roadmap-verdicts/<the vector>.json with verdict 'delivered' (and the test or record that proves it) or 'not-delivered' (with what is missing and the task ids that track the follow-up work), then run scripts/check-roadmap-verdict.py <the vector> — which is this task's acceptance. A refutation therefore closes the task and files the work, instead of stalling on a test that cannot pass; the roadmap and the queue both understand the record. Do not reserve .agents/roadmap-verdicts in your claim: the directory is exempt from the scope check precisely so a verdict commits under your source claim, and reserving it would overlap every other verification task and serialize them all. Reserve the source paths you will touch, and add a scope if the verdict needs to change the vector's narrative in .agents/roadmap.json. Evidence must name something real: a path that exists in the checkout, or an identifier (a test name) that appears in it. The checker verifies this, so a verdict cannot be closed by typing a claim.
title: Verify mastery: Provide an end-to-end ecosystem setup workflow
